principle: The neutral core remains dependency-free. Install a renderer only when the page requirement earns it.

integrations.name: GSAP
integrations.license: GSAP standard license; currently free including plugins and commercial use
useWhen: multiple scene states must align to one timeline
pinned scroll and video timing need precise control
DOM choreography exceeds native CSS transitions
avoidWhen: one IntersectionObserver reveal solves the page
the animation exists only to show that a library is installed

integrations.name: Three.js
useWhen: the visitor manipulates geometry, camera, lighting, or materials
procedural or personalized visuals matter
a rendered sequence cannot express the interaction
avoidWhen: the object only needs rotation or hotspots
a video or frame sequence tells the same story more reliably

integrations.name: model-viewer
integrations.role: simple GLB display, hotspots, and AR
useWhen: a product model needs orbit controls
hotspots or AR add value
Three.js would be unnecessary infrastructure
avoidWhen: the scene needs custom shaders, multiple coordinated objects, or procedural camera behavior

integrations.name: Spline
useWhen: a designer needs direct scene authoring
rapid interactive 3D iteration matters
an embed can carry the experience
avoidWhen: watermark-free export is required but the plan does not allow it
mobile GPU cost is too high
the page needs deep custom rendering control

integrations.name: Remotion
integrations.role: programmatic video, poster, and sequence rendering
integrations.license: Free for individuals and companies up to three people; larger companies generally need a company license
useWhen: one composition must render multiple aspect ratios
product data or code drives the visual
loops, transitions, posters, and social variants should share one source
avoidWhen: the site would unnecessarily ship React or Remotion in the browser

integrations.name: Theatre.js
integrations.role: visual timeline authoring for Three.js and DOM
integrations.license: Core Apache-2.0; Studio AGPL-3.0 and intended for authoring
useWhen: camera and object choreography needs a visual timeline
a Three.js scene has many approved beats
avoidWhen: a short GSAP timeline is easier to inspect
the page does not need persistent keyframed scene state

integrations.name: Rive
integrations.role: interactive vector animation and state machines
integrations.license: Web runtime MIT; editor/export access follows the active plan
useWhen: 2D motion must respond to real product state
a compact state machine is better than video
avoidWhen: a CSS transition handles the state

integrations.name: React Three Fiber
useWhen: the existing product is React and live 3D is justified
scene state should integrate with React state
avoidWhen: adding React exists only to reach Three.js
